verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's model-fallbacks and provider-selection docs describe automatic retries to alternate providers/models when the primary is down, rate-limited, or refuses to respond — directly matching the platform engineer's need to handle transient provider errors automatically, and this is corroborated by a community comment noting default fallback support without needing custom wrapper code. Missing for 10: explicit configuration of retry counts/backoff intervals on the *same* provider (evidence only covers fallback to a different provider/model, not literal retry policy tuning), and independent hands-on verification of retry behavior under real transient failures.
